classification.difficultyReason: Infer x≥0 from the nonnegative absolute value, derive y=±x, and apply the restriction to sketch two right-opening rays with their common endpoint included.

answer.short: $y=x$ or $y=-x$, with $x\geq0$: two rays from the origin opening to the right.
answer.worked: Since $|y|\geq0$, the relation requires $x\geq0$. For each such $x$, $y=x$ or $y=-x$. Draw these two rays, including their common endpoint at the origin.

spec.sourceRegion: Problem 9; answer graph at teacher PDF page 29, printed page 323
spec.description: Two blue diagonal rays meet at the origin and extend into the first and fourth quadrants, with continuation arrows. Black coordinate axes have x and y labels, no numerical ticks and no origin label.
